text: At its meeting on December 13, 14, and 15, 2023, City Council considered item MM13.5 – Appointment of Public Member to the Toronto Film, Television and Digital Media Board and appointed the following member to the board for a term of office starting on December 16, 2023 and ending on November 14, 2026. Sarah Farrell This vacancy was due to the resignation of Jinder Oujla-Chalmers effective December 5, 2023.
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board received the item for information.
